evidence: Authorize the primary Net/AlphaNet/NetDaemon virtual hierarchy and four AlphaNet no-op overrides currently represented by unrelated fastcall wrappers. Original constructor stores bind primary tables at 0x0066EB04, 0x0066EACC and 0x0066EF0C. Their observed six-slot prefixes distinguish inheritance from overrides. Preserve shared base-leaf identities as unresolved folded bindings, not AlphaMovie ownership, and preserve the unknown complete table bounds.

Original 0x00632D6B dispatches player addition at slot 1 with a name and ID; 0x00632633 dispatches deletion at slot 2; 0x00632F34 dispatches the SDK name-change message at slot 3; 0x00632F0C handles session loss at slot 4; 0x00632612 notifies host replacement at slot 5. Slot 0 remains a provisional two-word no-op interface. NetDaemon callback implementations exist only as nonexact seeds; retain them and add explicitly unfinished mapped product slots for link continuity, not pretend empty behavior is recovered.
